rows.grounds: compound: lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (letter) + rāśi (mass) + stha (situated); qualifies lakṣaṃ
numerical measure of the enjoined act
absolutive indicating completion of the act
compound vocative: sura (god) + arcita (worshipped); addresses the practitioner

items.question: What hundred-thousandfold act at the forehead letter-mass is enjoined for the god-worshipped practitioner?
premises: This act is situated in the forehead letter-mass.
The instruction is addressed to a god-worshipped practitioner.
items.inference: The god-worshipped practitioner must perform a hundred-thousandfold act at the forehead letter-mass.
uncertainties: The precise nature of the act counted as lakṣaṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand at the mass of letters situated in the forehead.
